floor 36 -> 21: sibling _spu_2pitch's split `curve *= 0x103B; curve >>= 12;` (-12), hit-arm-first closes s1's back-edge delay-slot residual (74/74 insns, -1), pre-loop statement-order sweep p21 (-2);

Floor 21 -> 20: splitting ONLY the upper inner-loop bound (hi = lower + next; hi >>= 12;) is worth -1; the rest of the split-compound-assignment family, the re-run 24-permutation pre-loop order sweep,

Floor 20 -> 19: the inner loop's accumulator inits move into the for-init comma expression (acc = 0 AFTER inner = 0) - ordinary C, 74/74 insns; the lever was localised by a semantically-invalid permut

frontier.hypothesis: The (move acc,zero / sll base,outer,5) inversion is now ONE insn apart (ours 33/34, target 33 = sll and 34 = move) and is the cheapest remaining order residual; if the accumulator's init can be emitted one slot later still, the floor should reach 18
frontier.mechanism: the sll is loop.c's LICM hoist of `outer << 5` placed by the preheader builder, and the for-init expansion put acc = 0 immediately before it; c1..c5 proved the sll's own position is not source-steerable, so the remaining degree of freedom is the acc init's position WITHIN the preheader, which sched1 then finalises
frontier.next_probe: run tools/sched_solver on the a1 body (order- and clock-exact for both scheduler passes) restricted to the inner-loop preheader block, and ask it whether the (move acc,zero / sll) pair is an INSN_PRIORITY tie that a live-length change can break; the s2 whatif.py measured the OTHER inversion's livelen deltas inert, so this pair has not been priced

frontier.hypothesis: The 5 residual seats are still set by local-alloc's suggested-register pass (qty_phys_copy_sugg / qty_phys_sugg): the target seats the pitch copy in $a0, an incoming-arg register freed by `move t8,a0` at insn 0, while we take the ordinary free $a3
frontier.mechanism: local_alloc's block_alloc runs before global_alloc and its suggestion scan is reported-not-scored by the current ra_solver model; its renumberings also seed global.c's regs_used_so_far. s2's inverse.py depth-2 was NEGATIVE for the 6-seat goal precisely because this input is unmodelled
frontier.next_probe: rebuild the s2 solo TU from the NEW a1 body (tmp/grind/_spu_pitch2note/s2/solo/ + extract_solo.py; the instrumented cc1 segfaults on the full main.i), run tools/ra_solver/local_extract.py --suggest (BB2_SUGG_DEBUG), price the pitch-copy / shift / outer quantities, then ask inverse.py local for the flip

frontier.hypothesis: The for-init comma-expression lever is not exhausted - it paid one point on the inner loop and was measured inert on the outer and scan loops, but it has not been crossed with the OTHER outer-body statements (lower, upper, step, curve)
frontier.mechanism: the same preheader-vs-body expansion split that moved `move acc,zero`; each outer-body assignment that can legally be phrased as part of a loop's init clause is a distinct emission position, and the a1..a9 sweep showed the winning positions are narrow (4 of 9)
frontier.next_probe: generate the cross-product of {lower, upper, step, curve} x {inner for-init, outer for-init, plain statement} on the a1 base with tmp/grind/_spu_pitch2note/s3/apply.py + the s4 sweep.ps1 harness, and re-run the 24-permutation pre-loop order sweep on any variant that reaches 18
